intro.title: Component Library Theming
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple themed component library by creating a reusable Button component that changes its appearance based on a global theme. You'll learn how to use React Context to manage and share theme data, like colors and styles, across different parts of your application. The main technologies involved are React, TypeScript for type safety, and the Context API for state management. By the end, you'll understand how to apply a consistent design system to your components, making them easy to customize and maintain.
intro.usecase: Component theming is essential for creating consistent, branded user interfaces across entire applications. In real-world products like admin dashboards, e-commerce platforms, or SaaS applications, theming allows developers to maintain visual harmony across components like data tables, form inputs, modals, and navigation panels. For example, a dashboard might use a dark theme for analytics displays while keeping forms in a light theme, all using the same component library. This pattern enables teams to quickly adapt interfaces for different brands, accessibility requirements, or user preferences while maintaining code consistency.
